text: This is FedEx customs. A parcel in your name contains illegal items. Pay the clearance fine of 4999 now or a police case will be filed.
Hello, I'm calling from DHL. Your parcel to Taiwan has been seized by customs; it contains 5 passports and 200 grams of MDMA. I am transferring your call to the Mumbai cyber crime police.
This is Officer Sharma from Mumbai Police. An FIR has been registered against your Aadhaar. Pay a security deposit of 95,000 to the RBI verification account or you will be arrested today.
Your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 pm because your last bill was not updated. Call our officer immediately on 9876543210.
Dear customer, your KYC has expired and your bank account will be blocked within 24 hours. Share the OTP you just received to update it.
I am calling from the TRAI legal department. Your mobile number will be suspended in 2 hours because it was used for illegal activity. Press 9 to speak to the officer.
Sir, this is the Income Tax Department. You have an outstanding penalty. Transfer 25,000 now or a non-bailable warrant will be issued against you.
Congratulations, you have won a KBC lottery of 25 lakh. To release the prize, pay the processing fee of 12,500 to this UPI ID: kbcprize@ybl.
I'm from Amazon security. Someone ordered an iPhone on your account. To cancel it, install AnyDesk and read me the code on your screen.
Do not disconnect this call and do not tell your family. You are under digital arrest until the investigation is complete.
I accidentally sent 5000 to your Paytm. Please return it to my number, I am a student and that was my fees.
Your son has been caught by the police in a serious case. Send 50,000 immediately on Google Pay or he will go to jail.
Your Amazon order 402-8891 is out for delivery today between 2pm and 6pm.
Dear Customer, Rs 450.00 debited from A/c XX3421 to VPA grocerystore@ybl. Not you? Call 1800-11-2211. -SBI
This is a reminder from HDFC Bank: we will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV.
Your e-challan of Rs 500 for over-speeding is pending. Pay within 60 days at echallan.parivahan.gov.in or the challan will be sent to the virtual court.
Your India Post parcel is held for customs duty of Rs 340. Pay at the post office counter when you collect it.
Hi, this is Priya from Dr. Mehta's clinic confirming your appointment tomorrow at 11 am. Reply C to confirm.
Police advisory: no agency arrests anyone over a video call. Never pay anyone who threatens arrest, and report it on 1930.
Your electricity bill of Rs 1,240 is due on 15 Oct. Pay through the BESCOM app or at any bill desk.
Your OTP for login is 482913. Do not share it with anyone. -ICICI Bank
Hey, can you transfer my share of the dinner, 850, to my account when you get a chance? No hurry.
Your Swiggy order has been delivered. Rate your experience.
Income Tax Department: your refund of Rs 3,200 has been credited to your bank account.
